Hurricane Isaias batters US Southeast, causing power outages and two deaths

Hurricane Isaias made landfall in the US Southeast, battering Florida and Alabama with extreme winds and flash flooding. The storm left approximately 800,000 people without power. Two fatalities have been reported. Officials warned of continued flooding and the possibility of tornadoes. The hurricane's path also raised concerns about potential impacts on fuel prices if refineries lost power.
